en: A postcard reproducing a richly illuminated medieval manuscript page (Book of Hours). The central miniature shows the Virgin Mary enthroned with the Christ Child, while a richly dressed noblewoman kneels in prayer before them. Borders are filled with gold and blue foliate vines, pomegranates, birds, and small narrative scenes with figures and horses. A large decorated initial introduces a Latin prayer.
